messages:
Maria Chen: Hey team — quick thread to lock down the outbound comms for the onboarding degradation that affected trial tenants last night. Need: (1) short customer status note, (2) exec summary for AEs/CSMs, (3) a scripted 'do not escalate to execs' response for frontline. I pasted drafts below — please review and mark who owns outreach.

Javed Patel: Thanks. Impact numbers? small sample list and severity?

Maria Chen: Impact: 8 trial tenants experienced delayed webhook deliveries between 02:14–02:45 UTC. 3 are flagged high-touch (onboarding P0). Root cause: transient routing bug in the auth proxy (we patched at 02:40 UTC). Mitigation: failover to fallback pool and a hotfix rolled. ETA for full verification: 6 hours.

Leo Ortiz: Suggest offering 7 free trial days + a 30-min enablement call for high-touch accounts. Also plan targeted re-ingest if webhooks missed.

Priya Singh: Keep customer email non-technical. They care about "what happened", "what we did", "what we will do for you", and the timeline.

Maria Chen: Draft customer status email (short):

```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We’re writing to let you know we experienced an onboarding delivery delay that affected your trial between 02:14–02:45 UTC. Our team patched the issue and deliveries are routing normally.

What we did: patched the routing issue, failed over impacted queues, and reprocessed backlog.
What we’re doing for you: offering 7 free trial days and optional 30-min enablement session. We’ll also recheck any missed items and confirm once complete.

Apologies for the interruption — reply to this message if you want the enablement session scheduled.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference CS Team
```

Maria Chen: Exec summary (for AE/CSM):
- Incident window: 02:14–02:45 UTC
- Impact: 8 trial tenants; 3 high-touch onboarding flows delayed
- Customer-facing: drafted status email + credit/enablement offer
- Next steps: outreach assigned, reingest verification, confirm resolved in SFDC case.

Javed Patel: Minor wording tweak: change "reprocessed backlog" -> "rechecked and requeued any missed items"

Maria Chen: Updated.

CS-Bot: Incident IR-2026-403 created, linked runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/IR-2026-403 (owner: infra-team).

Priya Singh: Hand-off script for frontline (short):
"We’re aware of a delivery delay impacting some trial customers earlier today. The issue has been patched and normal service has resumed. We’re offering affected customers 7 free trial days and a 30-minute enablement call. If the customer asks for technical detail, please escalate to your assigned CSM — do not escalate to Execs unless the customer explicitly requests executive engagement."

Leo Ortiz: I’ll own outreach to the 3 high-touch accounts (I have their contact list). @Maria can you drop the list and preferred time windows?

Maria Chen: Sharing offline list in 1:1. Action items:
- [ ] Leo: outreach to 3 high-touch (target: today EOD)
- [ ] Javed: bulk status email for other 5 trials (target: tomorrow AM)
- [ ] Priya: confirm credits issued and update Zendesk tags + SFDC case fields
- [ ] Maria: update postmortem skeleton and share draft for RCA review

Javed Patel: Noted — will prepare email + sending cadence. Please confirm CC list and signature format.

Priya Singh: After sending, tag cases with "onboard-delivery-delay" and set renewal-risk flag to "no-change" unless customer reports material business impact.

Leo Ortiz: Confirmed — will schedule calls and leave notes in SFDC.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. Please mark done on thread when complete. I’ll post the RCA draft in #postmortems channel once ready. :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: Approved wording from me. :white_check_mark:

Javed Patel: Sending draft to review in 30m.

CS-Bot: Reminder: SLA credit workflow initiated for affected accounts.
